{{Quote|This is the Valsedian asteroid belt. It is a rich trove of ore that can be turned into fuel, armor and weaponry for the war.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="TVO" />}}
The '''Valsedian asteroid belt''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-rich [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located deep within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Sensor scans show stable pressure outside, and trace atmosphere&hellip; it's cold, but survivable.''"<br />"''Breath masks it is, then.|Tyzen Xebec and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="TVO" />}}
[[File:Valsedian_mining_facility.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] working in [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]] inside the largest asteroid of the belt]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Valsedian asteroid belt contained a hidden base owned by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The base served as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility where [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] workers processed [[Ore/Legends|ore]] extracted from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the belt. The base was guarded by a group of individuals hired by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who had access to everything the facility had to offer, including a [[Wine/Legends|wine]] cellar that contained [[Ugnaught wine]].<ref name="TVO" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|I humbly bring bad news, Master. Valsedian is not in our control.''"<br />"''I am doubtful it ever was. It appears that mighty Jabba has outmaneuvered us. Such scheming, worthy of a Sith.|Asajj Ventress and Count Dooku|sr<ref name="TVO" />}}
During the Clone Wars, the Valsedian asteroid belt was suspected to have been sold to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by [[Torpo]] the Hutt, in breach of the terms of a treaty between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In response, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] set up a [[Mission to the Valsedian asteroid belt|mission]] to investigate this matter.<ref name="TVO" />

===Galactic Civil War===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established a base in the Valsedian asteroid belt. The base was later [[Battle of the Valsedian asteroid belt|decimated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a reward for this success, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] would eventually be given command of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="Despoilers3" />
